feature_name: Circular Reference Handling in Drizzle Schema Generation
description: Update the Drizzle schema generation system to properly handle circular relationships between collections without causing TypeScript errors. When generating database schemas via `payload generate:db-schema`, the system should detect circular references and use appropriate type-safe column references instead of creating invalid self-references.
functional_requirements: Detect circular relationships between collections during schema generation
Replace problematic column references with appropriate database-specific types (AnyPgColumn for PostgreSQL, AnySQLiteColumn for SQLite)
Maintain type safety while avoiding TypeScript compilation errors
Update test fixtures to validate circular reference handling works correctly
Ensure the fix works for complex circular chains (e.g., media → teams → organizations → media)
